name: Second Chances
overview: Scripture reveals the gracious heart of God who offers second chances through forgiveness and salvation. Isaiah encourages believers to forget past failures, while Lamentations reminds us that recalling God's faithfulness brings hope. Jonah's prayer from the fish's belly exemplifies repentance and God's readiness to restore. Jesus teaches the necessity of forgiving others repeatedly, reflecting God's boundless mercy, and John affirms that God's love is demonstrated by sending His Son not to condemn but to save, granting eternal life to all who believe.
